# LabelSure - Intelligent Food Packaging Compliance Platform

> Automated packaging OCR, regulatory compliance auditing under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 & Legal Metrology Rules, and A+ to F nutritional health grading.

## Documentation & Navigation Links
- [Platform Home](http://localhost:4173/): Food compliance intelligence overview and core workflow.
- [Multi-Image Scanner](http://localhost:4173/scanner): Packaging photo upload, camera studio, and automated OCR extraction.
- [Statutory Compliance Audit](http://localhost:4173/compliance-analysis): 5-way compliance verification against FSS Act 2006 and Legal Metrology.
- [Nutritional Health Grading](http://localhost:4173/health-analysis): A+ to F dietary quality scoring model and nutrient breakdown.
- [12-Month User Scan History](http://localhost:4173/history): Dynamic rolling 12-month user-scoped scan records.
- [AI Capabilities Catalog](http://localhost:4173/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable tools and API manifest.

## Optional / Extended Documentation
- [Full Regulatory Guidelines](http://localhost:4173/compliance-analysis): FSSAI Labelling and Packaging Regulations 2020.
- [Grading Methodology](http://localhost:4173/health-analysis): Nutrient thresholds and profiling algorithm.
